rows.en:
Annihilate the enemy of the U.N. Forces:
the Anti-U.N. Forces.
Commencing the operation to wipe out the U.N.'s foe: the "Anti-U.N. Forces." Annihilate the Anti-U.N. TYPE-29 fighter formation.

As part of conversion training for the
VF-0, engage in a mock battle.
rows.notes: Re-broken to the Japanese line sizes (40 / 44 bytes).

rows.en: The "VF-0": a variable fighter developed with the ASS-1's OverTechnology. To survive the battles ahead, you'll now undergo VF-0 conversion training.

Annihilate the Anti-U.N. Forces'
new variable fighter unit.
The Anti-U.N. Forces made a surprise attack with VFs built using our tech. Sortie at once and annihilate the Anti-U.N. variable fighters.

As part of your training,
fight a mock battle against Major Focker.
To prepare for the escalating Anti-U.N. war, we'll hold a mock battle drill. Win the mock battle against U.N. Forces ace Major Roy Focker.

To stop the theft of the AFOS fragment,
annihilate the Anti-U.N. Forces.
The Anti-U.N. Forces are trying to seize the AFOS fragment on Mayan Island. Expect unfamiliar underwater combat, but wipe out the Anti-U.N. at all costs.

To defend the AFOS fragment,
annihilate the Anti-U.N. Forces.
The Anti-U.N. Forces attack the Asuka to seize the AFOS fragment under study. Defend the carrier Asuka and annihilate the Anti-U.N. at all costs.

Escort the allies recovering the AFOS
fragment to the target area.
We'll now recover another AFOS fragment newly found on Mayan Island. Escort the allied units recovering it to the target area.

Wipe out the Anti-U.N. Forces so they
can't recover the Bird Human's head.
We lost the Bird Human's head in a fierce battle with the Anti-U.N. Forces. We can't let them recover it. Wipe out the Anti-U.N. Forces searching for it.

To seize the immense power of AFOS,
wipe out the Anti-U.N. Forces.
Both the U.N. Forces and the Anti-U.N. Forces now hold AFOS fragments. Wipe out the Anti-U.N. to claim the AFOS fragments for our U.N. Forces.

Wipe out the giant aliens who struck
back after the Macross's attack.
rows.notes: Re-broken to the Japanese line sizes (40 / 44 bytes).

rows.en: At its launch ceremony, the Macross fired its main gun at an unknown fleet. Battle with the aliens looks unavoidable. Get into intercept position now.
rows.notes: Shortened: briefing lines hold 78 bytes (2 lines). Shortened: briefing lines hold 78 bytes (2 lines).

rows.en:
Wipe out the giant alien ground forces
attacking the Macross.
To escape the giant aliens' attack, the Macross now attempts a space launch. Escort the blundering VF-1D while wiping out the giant alien ground forces.

Defend the Macross
during the Transformation.
Beginning the Transformation to fire the main gun at the giant alien fleet. Defend the Macross at all costs while the Transformation is under way.
Our rookies lack experience, so we'll now hold a mock battle as training. Win the mock battle against U.N. Forces ace Major Roy Focker.

Defend the Macross until
its main gun fires.
To break out of this defensive fight, we'll surprise-attack the giant aliens. Defend the Macross until its main gun fires.

To resupply, carry the containers
to the designated point.
With supplies drained by repeated battles, we'll restock at Sara Base on Mars. Recover the supply containers. If enemies appear, switch to wiping them out.
Destroy the enemies nearing the Macross.
Enemy units spotted approaching the Macross. A scramble has been ordered. Miss Macross may be on your mind, but go at once and wipe out the enemy.

Escort the Cat's Eye until the survey
of the giant aliens is complete.
Just short of Earth, the giant aliens have demanded the Macross surrender. We'll recon to learn their aims. Escort the Cat's Eye and wipe out the enemy.

To escape from the enemy ship,
head for the target area.
We've rescued Lt. Hayase and the others held captive on a Zentradi battleship, but we haven't escaped the enemy ship yet. Get out of it at all costs.

To make it back to Earth no matter what,
wipe out the Zentradi forces.
The Zentradi have surrounded the Macross to stop it from returning to Earth. It's a hard-line move, but destroy the Zentradi to break their encirclement.

Wipe out the Zentradi forces
that have attacked the Macross.
The Zentradi have attacked the Macross, back on Earth after a year away. Wipe out the Zentradi forces trying to smoke the Macross out into space.

To keep the enemy off the Macross,
wipe out the Zentradi forces.
A Zentradi battleship is closing fast on the Macross as it resupplies at sea. We can't let the Macross's resupply be interrupted. Wipe out the Zentradi.

To get the civilians safely onto Earth,
wipe out the Zentradi forces.
The Ontario Autonomous Zone has agreed to take in the Macross's civilians, but the Zentradi have appeared. Wipe them out so the civilians can be taken in.

Escort the liaison shuttle headed
for U.N. Forces HQ on Earth.
You'll now escort the liaison shuttle taking Capt. Hayase to U.N. HQ on Earth. Escort it until it reaches a safe zone, then switch to wiping out the enemy.

Beat the expert gamers at the smash-hit
game "Battroid Attack".

Head-to-Head Valkyrie Simulation  ~BATTROID ATTACK!!~
                                  PLEASE INSERT COIN(S)
rows.notes: Arcade attract-screen layout kept exactly as MUF shipped it (line break and space padding).

rows.en:
Wipe out the Zentradi forces
launching an all-out attack.
At humanity's first interstellar wedding, the Zentradi attacked the Macross in force. We've taken a first step to peace; don't stop now. Wipe out the enemy.
rows.notes: Shortened: briefing lines hold 78 bytes (2 lines). Shortened: briefing lines hold 78 bytes (2 lines).

rows.en:
To end the interstellar war,
destroy Boddole Zer.
rows.notes: TM had 'Golg Boddole Zer'; the Japanese here is the short form (Boddole Zer), and the glossary keeps the full name for titles. MI_060 (u2918), which writes the full name, keeps it.

rows.en: Fearing the power of Earth's culture, Boddole Zer attacks the Macross all-out. We'll use the Minmay Attack to overturn hopeless odds. Destroy Boddole Zer.

Put down the rioting Zentradi
at once.
Zentradi who can't fit in on Earth stole arms and are attacking civilian areas. We cannot let civilians come to harm. Put down the rampaging Zentradi.

To capture the automated spaceship
factory, seize control of the facility.
To build up our forces, we'll seize the Zentradi automated spaceship factory. Wipe out the Zentradi forces defending it and take the factory.
rows.notes: Shortened: briefing lines hold 78 bytes (2 lines). Shortened: briefing lines hold 78 bytes (2 lines).

rows.en:
Wipe out Quamzin's faction, which is
trying to steal the micronization device.
Quamzin, who won't coexist with Earthlings, is raiding the factory to steal the micronization device. We can't allow that. Wipe out Quamzin's faction.

To rescue the hostages,
wipe out Quamzin's faction.
Quamzin has taken civilians hostage and is demanding a battleship as ransom. Rescuing the hostages safely comes first. Wipe out Quamzin's faction.

Wipe out Quamzin's faction, which is
trying to steal the reaction engine.
Quamzin's faction is raiding the industrial zone to steal the reaction engine. Wipe them out to protect the reaction engine in the industrial complex block.

To protect the Macross and Macross City,
wipe out Quamzin's faction.
Out to destroy the Macross, Quamzin's faction has suddenly hit Macross City. Wipe them out at once to protect the Macross and the people of Macross City.

To make it home to Earth,
annihilate the Zentradi forces.
As the Macross heads home from beyond the solar system, the Zentradi appear. First break their formation with reaction weapons, then annihilate them.

Capture the U.N. Forces pilot who is
flying a Valkyrie without authorization.
We've spotted a pilot flying a Valkyrie around Saturn without permission. Unauthorized use of a Valkyrie won't be tolerated. Capture the pilot at once.

To rescue the hostages,
head to the target area immediately.
The Zentradi have taken Macross crew members captive. To rescue the hostages, infiltrate the enemy ship and go at once to where they're thought to be held.

As part of your training,
fight a mock battle against Max.
To prepare for relentless Zentradi raids, we'll now conduct special training. Win a mock battle against the rumored genius pilot, Maximilian Jenius.

Immediately annihilate the Meltrandi
forces approaching the Macross.
rows.notes: TM 'Annihilate the Meltrandi forces closing in on the Macross at once' read as if the Meltrandi were closing in at once; moved 'immediately' to the verb.

rows.en: Bogeys believed to be the all-female Meltrandi forces are nearing the Macross. To keep them from getting any closer, annihilate the Meltrandi at once.

To end the interstellar war,
defeat Golg Boddole Zer.
Peace with the Zentradi up in smoke, Boddole Zer attacks the Macross all-out. We'll use the Minmay Attack to overturn hopeless odds. Defeat Boddole Zer.

As part of your training, fight
mock battles with the Destroid squads.
To prepare for emergencies like a Zentradi remnant revolt or unseen threats, regular U.N. Forces training begins. Beat each Destroid squad in mock battle.

Annihilate the rioting
Zentradi remnants.
Rioting Zentradi remnants have ignored a call to surrender and still run wild. To put down the riot at once, annihilate the Zentradi remnants.

To assess your aptitude as a test pilot,
fight the Valkyrie squad in a mock battle.

uncertain: Mission objective rows (strMission): most TM rows exceed the per-line estimate (125% of the Japanese line), as MUF shipped them; the widest shipped objective line in the corpus is 274 px, so lines up to ~274 px were kept and new rows written within that.
u2891: kept MUF's padded two-line arcade layout in a WRAP row instead of a single paragraph.
